title: Shortest Bridge
description: Find the shortest bridge to connect two islands in a binary matrix by flipping 0s to 1s.
pseudocode:
1. Find first island using DFS and add all its coordinates to a queue
2. While queue is not empty:
3.   Pop current cell, explore neighbors
4.   If neighbor is 0, mark as 1, increment distance and push to queue
5.   If neighbor is 1 and not part of first island, return distance

steps.note: Identify the first island (1s) using DFS and store coordinates in queue
Begin BFS from the first island to find the nearest 0
Flip adjacent 0 to 1 and update distance
